name: TagInput
label: Tag input
description: Multi-value text input with entries held as removable tags.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the full tag array whenever a tag is added
or removed. The native `onChange` still fires for draft-text edits, which
keeps the standard React event signature for form libraries.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum number of tags — at the limit the input stops accepting new ones

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute)

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — shows error styling and message

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message displayed below the control

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a tag's remove button, given the tag. Defaults to "Remove <tag>".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the <input>

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the committed tags submit with an enclosing
form through hidden inputs, one entry per tag, nothing while disabled.
The draft text being typed is never submitted. Also the fallback for the
element id (`id || name || label`).
